top_signals.title: Danamon’s Kawasaki Stays Bullish on Indonesia Growth
top_signals.summary: Bank Danamon Indonesia President Director Nobuya Kawasaki says Indonesia’s economy remains resilient despite concerns over the country’s outlook, pointing to strong loan demand and consumer activity. He speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of 'Singapore Fintech Festival 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)
